DIAGNOSIS READY: C. difficile infection

The clinical picture of acute watery diarrhea following recent levofloxacin therapy is highly suggestive of a C. difficile infection, despite the conflicting instruction in the data. While your white blood cell count indicates stress, the specific history points to antibiotic-associated colitis rather than a urinary tract infection.
